prs.title: fix: inherit `watch` from the root config in projects
prs.author: nstepien
prs.body:
Fixes #11721

Projects did not inherit `watch` from the root config, so `vitest run` in some contexts would run projects with only half the workers available, as if `watch` was enabled.

Since `watch` defaults to:
```ts
  watch: !isCI && process.stdin.isTTY && !isAgent,
```
the `watch: false` test case can only catch regressions when the test is ran locally by a human.

Disclaimer: Claude helped me with reporting the issue and this PR's implementation.
I've reviewed the PR myself, and wrote the description myself.

prs.title: fix(mocker): don't change the original prototype chain
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
Fixes #11718

- `spy: true` no longer shares a function prototype without own methods (generators, `Child.prototype = Object.create(Base.prototype)`), so `mockImplementation()` doesn't re-parent the original.
- automock gives generator functions a new prototype instead of the original one.
- A class prototype with a custom `Symbol.toStringTag` is now mocked like any other prototype. Before, it was shared as is: automock didn't mock its methods, and `spy: true` instances returned `undefined`.
- Docs: `spy: true` replaces methods of objects and class prototypes in place, which affects built-ins and externalized dependencies everywhere.

The generator test is from @maschwenk's branch.

prs.title: fix(browser): don't hang in `page.viewport()`
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
Fixes #10831

- In UI mode, `setIframeViewport` waits for the Vue update instead of an animation frame. The frame never comes when the page is not rendered.
- `page.viewport()` rejects with the provider error instead of waiting for the test timeout. The error points to the call.

prs.title: fix(mocker): use root __mocks__ for linked packages (fix #7708)
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
Fixes #7708

When a package name passed to `vi.mock` resolves outside of `node_modules` (like a workspace package), Vitest now looks for the mock in `<root>/__mocks__` first, the same as for an installed package. Otherwise, it falls back to the `__mocks__` folder next to the resolved file.

Also updates the docs: `deps.moduleDirectories` is no longer needed for this, and adding a package there externalizes it, so `vi.mock` doesn't apply to its imports.

prs.title: fix(cli): use camelCase for sinceLastRun help
prs.author: fengmk2
prs.body:
Help displays `--since-last-run` beside camelCase options such as `--lastFailed`. Remove the explicit aliases so the default command and `vitest list` display `--sinceLastRun`. Both spellings remain accepted.

Relevant help output excerpts:

**Before**

```console
$ vitest --help
  --since-last-run                                           Run only the tests whose recorded dependencies were modified since the last run of the test, and the tests that failed in their last run. Enables --changed, --experimental.recordDependencies and the mtime provider (default: false)
  --lastFailed                                               Run only the tests that failed in the last run (default: false)

$ vitest list --help
  --since-last-run                                           Print only the tests whose recorded dependencies were modified since the last run of the test, and the tests that failed in their last run (default: false)
```

**After**

```console
$ vitest --help
  --sinceLastRun                                             Run only the tests whose recorded dependencies were modified since the last run of the test, and the tests that failed in their last run. Enables --changed, --experimental.recordDependencies and the mtime provider (default: false)
  --lastFailed                                               Run only the tests that failed in the last run (default: false)

$ vitest list --help
  --sinceLastRun                                             Print only the tests

prs.title: feat(browser): add failure-only trace view mode
prs.author: hi-ogawa
prs.body:
- closes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/10310
- supersedes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/10356
- related https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11592, https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/11594

Trace view records every step of every test and sends each one to the server as it happens, with a snapshot per step, so every passing test pays for it. This PR adds a `'failure-only'` mode that keeps traces only for failed tests, at no cost to passing tests. The trace timeline printed on failure (#11594) works the same in this mode, because it reads the failed test's trace.

### Usage

```ts
browser: {
  traceView: 'failure-only',
  // or
  traceView: { mode: 'failure-only', ... }
}
```

`browser.traceView.enabled` is deprecated in favor of `browser.traceView.mode`, which covers the same on and off switch and also selects the new mode.

### Performance

`'failure-only'` adds no measurable cost to passing tests. Each number below is the average time of one operation in a passing test over 100 calls after 10 warmup calls, taking the median of 3 runs on macOS (Apple Silicon) with headless chromium. The page has a 1000-row list, so the per-step DOM snapshot of `'on'` shows up clearly.

| Operation in a passing test | Trace view off | `'failure-only'` | `'on'` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `click` | 50.0 ms | **same as off** | 134.3 ms (+169%) |
| `expect.element` assertion | 2.6 ms | **same as off** | 108.0 ms (×42) |

prs.title: fix(vm): strip hashbang before compiling CommonJS dependencies
prs.author: cwoebker
prs.body:
Fixes #11722

As described in the issue common JS files that started with the hashbang `#!` were not processed correctly. With this fix, we replace the hashbang with the comment prefix `//` before further processing, keeping all column and character markers identical.

Given the size of the change, I have not added tests so far, but am happy to add them if needed!
